non_canonical_engineering._doc: These thresholds extend canonical BRACKET_RULES.md (which treats B4 and B5 as policy-identical) with deliberate engineering choices that capture WotC's design intent (cEDH-density distinction). Documented here so future readers know they are not strictly canonical.

b4_max_5.rationale: Canonical WotC says unlimited GCs at B4. Capping at 5 forces decks with 6+ GCs into B5, capturing the cEDH-density distinction. Without this cap, B5 is structurally unreachable because the bracket-walk's first-match logic stops at B4.

b5_min_6.rationale: Canonical WotC says no minimum criteria for B5. Setting a 6-GC floor prevents low-GC decks from accidentally landing at B5 when B4 has been pushed past via b4_max_5; floor anchors B5 to actual cEDH-density compositions.
